text: On Lewis's resolution of the grandfather paradox, when the time traveler fails to kill her grandfather the failure is explained by ordinary causal factors (the gun jams, she hesitates, a passer-by intervenes) rather than by any special 'protection' of the timeline.
explanation: This is Lewis's central point: the self-consistency of the single spacetime is not a separate intervening law but simply a feature of the one fixed history, so each failure has a mundane causal explanation. Lewis is emphatic that no supernatural or magical force prevents the killing; the consistency constraint operates through ordinary causal mechanisms rather than by violating them. Hence the statement is true.
